workflow.name: Check every Transarch object package of a folder: send the valid ones as they are, list the others for correction
workflow.description: Template, first of two. Goes through every package of a folder WITHOUT unpacking any: a bash step lists the files of packagesDir that match packagePattern, and for each one, in name order, a script verifies the checksum, extracts only the audit and the metadata CSV, and the metadata is validated against the feed dataschema. A package that passes is sent AS IT IS (same name, same version) when sendValidPackages is true, and is otherwise left alone. A package that does not pass is NOT touched and NOT sent: it is written to the quarantine list - category correct when it can be read and only its metadata needs correcting, category manual when no workflow can handle it (wrong checksum, not a package, counts that do not agree) - and the run GOES ON with the next package. The second template, _TEMPLATE-objunpack-correct-quarantined, takes the list and unpacks, rebuilds and resends the packages of category correct. The list is the file named by quarantineList, by default in the shared files, where it can be read from the GUI; a new run keeps the earlier list under another name and starts a new one. THE SENT LIST: every package sent is recorded, by name, in the file named by sentList - by default in the shared files, the same file for both templates - and the List packages step leaves out every package whose name is in it, so that no run sends a package twice, even after it was corrected and sent as version + 1; to send one again on purpose, delete its line. BEFORE THE FIRST RUN: 1) the four scripts where the steps can find them - list-packages.sh, objunpack-precheck.sh, quarantine-list.sh, sent-list.sh - in the server scripts directory, or uploaded from the Files panel with their FULL PATH written in each Script field (four steps use quarantine-list.sh); the host needs bash and tar; 2) packagesDir and packagePattern; 3) feedDir must hold the feed dataschema.json; 4) the delimiter of the Check package metadata step is written here as a comma and is not taken from the package: set it to the delimiter the packages use, or every package is quarantined; 5) ftpsTarget, and sendValidPackages (true: the FTPS step, on hold, so the run waits at every valid package - untick On hold to send without stopping; false: nothing is sent, the run only checks and lists). AFTER A PACKAGE IS SENT, the audit and the metadata extracted from it are deleted (deleteOnSuccess on the FTPS step: the package's own folder under the Look inside step directory); those of a package put in the list are kept, beside its validation report, for whoever corrects it. Remove the parameter to keep them all. TRANSITIONS: a run may take at most orchestrator.max-transitions node transitions (500 unless configured) between two releases from a hold; a package sent as it is takes eleven. To go through more packages in one run, add the workflow variable maxTransitions, for example 2000 (it can only raise the limit, up to 100000). Nothing here changes the packages or their folder.
